title: Descent of bounded finitely presented complex data
statement: Let I be a directed set and let (S_i)_{i\in I} be an inverse system of quasi-compact, quasi-separated schemes with affine transition morphisms, where S_i=\operatorname{Spec}(R_i) for Noetherian rings R_i, and let S=\varprojlim_i S_i=\operatorname{Spec}(R). Fix i\in I, let X_i be a finitely presented S_i-scheme [def-pc-scheme], put X=X_i\times_{S_i}S and X_j=X_i\times_{S_i}S_j for j\ge i [def-pc-base-change], and let G^\bullet be a bounded complex of finitely presented \mathcal{O}_X-modules. Then, after replacing i by some j\ge i, there is a bounded complex H_j^\bullet of finitely presented \mathcal{O}_{X_j}-modules whose base change to X is isomorphic to G^\bullet.
